FINAL IVX IA SENIOR-DEVELOPER COMPLETION
HIGHEST PRIORITY — COMPLETE THE REMAINING CAPABILITY GAPS

Do not add more decorative actions.
Do not issue another global parity claim.
Continue from the existing IVX IA engineering-action implementation.

OBJECTIVE

Certify IVX IA as a real owner-controlled senior engineering executor by
proving persistent autonomy, truthful verification, complete production
execution, recovery, release management, database safety and real-device
results.

==================================================
1. REVOKE UNSUPPORTED GLOBAL PARITY
==================================================

Preserve the previous claim in the ledger but mark it:

REVOKED — TOOL CAPABILITY WAS CONFUSED WITH WHOLE-PRODUCT PARITY

Current truthful status:

ENGINEERING TOOLING: STRONG
AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION: PARTIAL
RELEASE MANAGEMENT: PARTIAL
PHYSICAL QA: NOT FULLY VERIFIED
WHOLE-PRODUCT PARITY: NOT PROVEN

==================================================
2. IMPLEMENT MULTI-LAYER STATUS
==================================================

Every task must independently record:

DESIGNED
CODED
UNIT_TESTED
INTEGRATION_TESTED
SECURITY_TESTED
COMMITTED
DEPLOYED
LIVE_API_VERIFIED
LIVE_UI_VERIFIED
PHYSICAL_ANDROID_VERIFIED
PHYSICAL_IOS_VERIFIED
OWNER_ACCEPTED

Do not use one generic PASS.

==================================================
3. ACTIVATE PERSISTENT AUTONOMY
==================================================

Deploy a real persistent worker and scheduler.

Required:

- durable database-backed queue
- task lease
- heartbeat
- checkpoint
- retry
- idempotency
- cancellation
- dead-letter queue
- restart recovery
- duplicate-worker prevention
- duplicate-commit prevention
- duplicate-deployment prevention
- two-hour reports
- owner dashboard

Prove work continues after Rork closes.

==================================================
4. FIX VERIFYING TIMEOUT
==================================================

No task may remain at VERIFYING indefinitely.

Implement:

- maximum stage duration
- progress timestamp
- heartbeat timeout
- TIMED_OUT state
- retry policy
- checkpoint resume
- owner alert
- cancellation
- exact failure reason

Test normal completion, hanging endpoint, worker termination, Render restart,
network failure and retry exhaustion.

==================================================
5. FIX IVX IA CHAT RELIABILITY
==================================================

Implement canonical ordering with:

- server timestamp
- stable message ID
- deterministic secondary sort
- optimistic-message reconciliation
- duplicate prevention
- pagination continuity
- realtime continuity
- restart persistence
- correct latest-message loading
- reference resolution
- conversation summary

Test 100 rapid messages, offline/reconnect, app restart and backend restart.

==================================================
6. COMPLETE AUTHENTICATION AS FIRST REAL TASK
==================================================

Use IVX IA, not Rork narrative, to complete:

- owner login
- every public member role registration
- Amazon SES email verification
- password reset
- session persistence
- role routing
- server authorization
- account recovery
- trusted devices
- fingerprint/Face ID
- physical Android verification

IVX IA must execute:

INSPECT
→ DIAGNOSE
→ PATCH
→ TEST
→ REVIEW
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ COMMIT
→ DEPLOY
→ LIVE VERIFY
→ PHYSICAL VERIFY
→ REPORT

==================================================
7. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
==================================================

Builder, reviewer, tester and verifier must be separate roles.

Only the verifier may recommend VERIFIED.

The verifier must independently retrieve:

- GitHub SHA
- Render deployment
- runtime SHA
- live endpoint result
- database state
- APK metadata
- landing artifact
- email delivery evidence
- physical-device evidence

==================================================
8. DATABASE MIGRATION CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Execute one real owner-approved migration.

Required:

- impact analysis
- backup/rollback plan
- migration
- constraints
- indexes
- RLS
- before/after counts
- application compatibility
- rollback rehearsal or safe proof

Writing a migration file alone does not count.

==================================================
9. REAL AUTONOMOUS FIX CYCLE
==================================================

Choose one real production defect and execute it entirely through IVX IA.

Required evidence:

TASK ID
CONVERSATION ID
CONTEXT SOURCES
FILES INSPECTED
ROOT CAUSE
PATCH
TESTS
REVIEW
OWNER APPROVAL
COMMIT SHA
DEPLOYMENT ID
RUNTIME SHA
LIVE RESULT
PHYSICAL RESULT
TRACE IDS
FINAL STATUS

==================================================
10. NEW MODULE CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Build one complete IVX module from owner request.

Required:

- requirements
- architecture
- database
- API
- UI
- roles
- tests
- deployment
- monitoring
- documentation
- real-device verification

Do not count scaffolding as a complete module.

==================================================
11. RELEASE MANAGEMENT
==================================================

Create one canonical release manifest containing:

REPOSITORY
BRANCH
GITHUB SHA
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID
RUNTIME SHA
APK VERSION
VERSION CODE
APK SHA-256
EMBEDDED SHA
PUBLIC DOWNLOAD URL
DATABASE MIGRATION VERSION
ROLLBACK RELEASE
TEST RESULTS
OWNER ACCEPTANCE

Verify the public artifact matches the manifest.

==================================================
12. REAL EVALUATION
==================================================

Execute the actual task evaluation dataset.

Do not report framework tests as intelligence results.

Score separately:

- architecture
- coding
- debugging
- testing
- database
- deployment
- security
- recovery
- release management
- evidence integrity
- business reasoning
- conversation continuity

Use:

PROVEN
SUPPORTED
PARTIAL
NOT_PROVEN

==================================================
13. PHYSICAL DEVICE CERTIFICATION
==================================================

On a real Android production APK test:

- login
- registration
- email verification
- password reset
- session restart
- chat ordering
- autonomous task status
- biometric unlock
- deep links
- network recovery

Test iOS when infrastructure is available.

API or emulator tests cannot be labeled physical-device verification.

==================================================
FINAL SENIOR-DEVELOPER VERDICT
==================================================

Return:

ENGINEERING TOOLING:
PERSISTENT AUTONOMY:
TASK RECOVERY:
CHAT RELIABILITY:
AUTHENTICATION:
DATABASE MIGRATIONS:
CODE EXECUTION:
DEPLOYMENT:
RELEASE MANAGEMENT:
SECURITY:
PHYSICAL ANDROID:
PHYSICAL IOS:
NEW MODULE:
INDEPENDENT APP:
EVALUATION SCORE:
EVIDENCE INTEGRITY:
OWNER ACCEPTANCE:

FINAL VERDICT:

SENIOR ENGINEERING TOOLING VERIFIED
or

SENIOR DEVELOPER EXECUTION VERIFIED
or

PARTIAL — list exact remaining capability and evidence

Do not use “Rork-level parity” unless a blinded comparative evaluation
proves parity for coding, deployment, release management, physical QA and
whole-product reliability.
